classification: Self-validation reporting gap (tooling defect in the independent check itself)
packages: 2 of 99 packages (Discover Network Credit; Moneris Canada Credit) - the same 2 that carry Root cause B of N12-01
affected_scope: 16 of the 309 REJECTED_FINAL test cases (5%) are completely invisible in test_cases/test_case_validation.json
example: Discover Network and Moneris Canada both report test_cases/test_case_validation.json = {valid: true, findings: []}, yet 10 and 6 of their own test cases (respectively) carry verification.status=REJECTED_FINAL with a RULE_CHECK_MISMATCH reason recorded on the test case itself.
issue: test_case_validation.json is the one file whose entire purpose is to surface exactly this kind of rule_check failure, and it already does so correctly for the other 18 affected packages (rule_check id LEG-TXN-TYPE) - it simply does not do so for rule_check id SPLIT-TENDER-CARD-B. An auditor who trusts only test_case_validation.json (as a quick per-package health check) will undercount the true number of broken packages by 2 and broken test cases by 16, with no indication anything was missed.
acceptance_criteria: test_case_validation.json's findings/valid fields are generated from the complete set of each test case's own verification.status/reasons (every RULE_CHECK_MISMATCH, not only LEG-TXN-TYPE); re-running it against the current packages produces valid:false for Discover Network and Moneris Canada with the SPLIT-TENDER-CARD-B findings included.
